changes.text: TactileLab In-Hand Rotation: 20 real rollouts (6,000 steps at 10 Hz, 10 objects) of sim-to-real rotation policies on a 4-finger LEAP-module hand with a TacTip optical sensor on each fingertip, raw 224x224 tactile images; public on Hugging Face (1.9 GB, license not stated).

ExoBridge: 1,215 paired demonstrations over 4 tasks with one bare hand on camera and the other in a DexUMI-family exoskeleton with 120-taxel arrays on thumb, index and middle fingertips; release of RGB, tactile and encoder data announced in the paper.

RSS Dual-Arm Tactile: 100 teleoperated tube-pour trajectories (plus 9 labelled failures) on two xArm6 arms with BrainCo Revo2 hands wearing Tujian (Tachin) tactile gloves, head and two wrist cameras; Hugging Face gate with manual approval, no paper.
ExoBridge: predicts fingertip contact, tactile intensity and exoskeleton motion from bare-hand video (any-contact AUROC 0.916, intensity r 0.790); evaluation code announced.

DexFLEX: contact-aware controller that reads FlexiTac 10x6 fingertip arrays on a LEAP hand and turns fingertip-motion drafts into joint targets, raising real teleoperation success from 29.2% to 78.3% (CoRL 2026); no code statement.

OccluDex: point-cloud and touch masked autoencoder pretrained on 1,690 WiseGlove human sequences (19 channels), used by a Shadow Hand policy with 19 FSRs; 85% and 70% zero-shot real success; no code statement.

HuTact: hand representation pretrained on 24 h of human hand-object data and 44 min of Revo2 play, read with Revo2 fingertip touch on a Unitree G1 (88.26% grasp Macro-F1 with 25% labels); no code statement.

CARD: retargets 744-taxel glove, mocap and video demonstrations into contact force targets and replays them on a Sharpa Wave hand with a fingertip-force tracker (4/30 to 25/30 replay success); code 'Link to come'.
Robot Synesthesia: in-hand rotation policy that turns 16 Allegro-hand FSR contacts into a tactile point cloud, trained in Isaac Gym and run on the real hand (ICRA 2024); code on GitHub (MIT).
TactoFind: touch-only localization, identification and grasping with GelSight 360 fingertips on a 3-finger D'Claw, 59.4% real-world retrieval (ICRA 2023); no code released.
TacTip (TacTip family): linked to the TactileLab In-Hand Rotation dataset (four TacTip fingertips on a LEAP-module hand).
TachinGlove: linked to RSS Dual-Arm Tactile, whose card names a Tujian (途见) tactile glove on each robot hand.
